title: The Switchboard image is Node 24 Alpine with @powerhousedao/switchboard installed from npm at the release tag; its entrypoint installs PH_PACKAGES, runs Kysely migrations when PH_REACTOR_DATABASE_URL is Postgres, then starts the server
content:
The Switchboard target is **Node.js 24 (Alpine)** with pnpm and the `@powerhousedao/switchboard` package installed at image build time from the npm registry at the requested release tag — not a pre-initialized project with Prisma, as the earlier image was. At startup the entrypoint:

1. Installs any packages listed in `PH_PACKAGES` (pnpm)
2. Runs the reactor Postgres migrations (**Kysely**) if `PH_REACTOR_DATABASE_URL` points at a Postgres URL — PGlite migrations run automatically inside the server
3. Starts the Switchboard server

Two ways to load custom packages server-side, matching where they run: `PH_PACKAGES` — comma-separated packages installed from the npm registry via pnpm before start — or `PH_REGISTRY_PACKAGES` — comma-separated packages loaded over HTTP from `PH_REGISTRY_URL` (default `https://registry.vetra.io`) at start. A custom image adds server-side packages at build time with `RUN pnpm add --shamefully-hoist @powerhousedao/my-custom-package`.

Core variables: `PORT` (`3000`, exported as `PH_SWITCHBOARD_PORT`), `PH_SWITCHBOARD_PORT` (explicit override), `PH_DEFAULT_DRIVE_TYPE` (`powerhouse/document-drive` or `powerhouse/reactor-drive`), `PH_SWITCHBOARD_PUBLIC_URL` (public origin used for the remote attachment service, default `http://localhost:$PORT`), `LOG_LEVEL` (`info`). Monitoring: `SENTRY_DSN`, `SENTRY_ENV`, `SENTRY_TRACING_ENABLED` (`false` = errors-only), `TEMPO_ENDPOINT` (OTLP HTTP traces), `PYROSCOPE_SERVER_ADDRESS`. Health check: `curl -f http://127.0.0.1:3000/health`; the service starts only after Postgres reports healthy.
